Last night, I went to the Senate floor to refute Democrat lies about the SAVE America Act.

This vital legislation requires proof of citizenship to register for federal elections. It requires photo identification when casting a ballot.

Nothing radical. Nothing extraordinary.

Nothing that millions of Americans don't already do to board an airplane, cash a check, enter a federal building, purchase certain medications, or pick up tickets at will-call.

"Noncitizen voting is already illegal."

Exa
